manufacturerHowToIndexRecheck20261015.evidenceScope: The index lists a general adjustment video, but provides no textual transcript, Team Pro-specific boot dimensions, or rule for choosing between overlapping sizes.

fitInterpretation.overlap: S/M and M both include men's US 7.0–10.0. The manufacturer presents both ranges without explaining the intended selection when they overlap.
fitInterpretation.advice: Treat the chart as a recommended sizing range, not a unique mapping. Trial-fit the actual boot and check footbed support, heel/toe centering, strap position and ladder adjustment; use physical fit to resolve overlapping or boundary sizes.
limits: The product page does not publish model-specific boot-shell dimensions or strap-length limits by binding size.
The size selector and published size ranges do not establish current stock in each size.
